baseline.includes: revalidated uncommitted P2; fingerprints in baseline-manifest.json
baseline.excludes: /workspace/Guitar earlier explicit-timeline candidate as current implementation

goDerivedCandidates: authored event identity, exact written time and explicit continuation observations
notation/playback policy separation derived from alphaTab
music21 offline comparison on explicitly comparable inputs
outOfScope: automatic harmonic segmentation or progression grammar
automatic local/modal key, tonicization or modulation
new product dependency installation or publication

roles.root: orchestration, evidence reconciliation and final gate

decisionMeaning.ADOPT: retain demonstrated compatible contract/principle; not an authorization to embed an entire library
decisionMeaning.ADAPT: usable idea with explicit product adapter/policy requirements
decisionMeaning.DEFER: candidate requires later evidence/contract, not current implementation
decisionMeaning.REJECT: specific proposed use conflicts with confirmed contract
decisionMeaning.GO: applicability to a stated subset; not release readiness or architecture selection
decisionMeaning.NO-GO: the specified use fails current applicability criteria
